flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, with Democrats now the favoured party. The Democrats Scott Colom in [[Mississippi]] and Josh Turek in [[Iowa]] each gained a lot of ground, and the market treats both as predicted flips. The projected Senate count is now 53-47, down from 54-46, still a result in which Democrats gain control.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds for [[Texas]] moved sharply toward the Democrat Gina Hinojosa, and the market now shows a predicted flip there. [[Nevada]] saw a similar sharp move, with the Democrat Aaron Ford gaining ground and also marked as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher also gained ground sharply.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the House rose by a sizable amount, with Democrats still the favoured party. In [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]], the Democrat Lakesha Womack gained sharply and the race is a predicted flip, and the Democrat J. D. Ford also advanced sharply in [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]], another predicted flip.
